item.title: Color as a Generative Principle in the Work of Sonia Delaunay
item.description:
An art-historical investigation into the autonomy of color in Sonia Delaunay's artistic practice.
The research explores simultaneous contrast, Orphism, visual perception, painting, textile design, modular structures and the relationship between modernist color theory and contemporary digital visual systems.
